To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the reconstruction of a small subregion of the interior of an object using a limited-angle data set is possible.

the proposed method is able to achieve a high-quality image reconstruction with a reduced amount of data, and that it is able to achieve this by utilizing a subregion that is smaller than the entire image and by using a nearly piecewise constant approximation of the image.

the proposed algorithm can achieve a high-quality interior reconstruction of an object with a small subregion of a few voxels in a large region-of-interest, and the reconstruction quality is not affected by the presence of a large region-of-interference.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the reconstruction of the interior of a region of interest (ROI) from measurements of the exterior of a larger region.
the development of an interior region-of-interest (ROI) reconstruction algorithm using a small, approximately piecewise constant sub-region of the object to be reconstructed.
the development and implementation of a new approach to image reconstruction for the interior of a region of interest (ROI) in a three-dimensional (3D) positron emission tomography (PET) scan.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of the small subregion of interest (ROI) technique in the context of interior tomographic reconstruction is a viable and effective method for reducing the computational cost of the interior problem while still providing a good reconstruction of the interior region of interest.
, for a given number of projections, the image reconstruction quality of the proposed algorithm is superior to that of the conventional filtered backprojection algorithm.
the proposed method is a promising tool for the reconstruction of the interior region of interest of a large region of interest.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method can be used to reconstruct the interior region-of-interest from the exterior region-of-interest with the help of a small subregion.
the interior ROIs are reconstructed by using the information in the exterior ROIs and the exterior ROIs are reconstructed with the aid of the interior ROIs.
the reconstruction quality of interior region-of-interest (ROI) is comparable with the reconstruction quality of the whole image for the same number of measurements.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a nearly piecewise constant region-of-interest (ROI) reconstruction can provide high-resolution, high-contrast, high-quality reconstructions of a small region-of-interest in a large field-of-view (FOV), while using a very small ROI reconstruction subregion and a small number of projections.
it is possible to use a very small region-of-interest to reconstruct a large region.
the region-of-interest (ROI) reconstruction problem for a small, nearly constant subregion can be solved using a simple interior reconstruction method, such as filtered backprojection.
